messages.subject: Disconnected from server as soon as I open URL
parts:

I know my files are large, and that I can't upgrade to larger than 1GB (XL and higher) without paying. Before I pay though, I Just want to be sure that this is the issue. Can anyone verify this? thank you! 

Hannah
